ns2:course.label: Spanish Art 1700-1900
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the rich visual cultures of Spain from the arrival of the Bourbon dynasty at the beginning of the eighteenth century through the years immediately following the "National Disaster" and Spain's defeat in the War of 1898. The course will examine a variety of themes: from the mythologized loves of Goya, to the grandeur of canvases recreating Spain's history; from Spanish Romanticism to the development of Mondernismo and the advent of Pablo Picasso. Previous introductory level art history course recommended. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours.
